finality.note: instant, final settlement (EIP-3009) — no on-rail reversal; recourse is the record's elected forum, and finality is never represented as dispute resolution (PAY-3/RCS-5). The atrHash welded as the EIP-3009 nonce MUST be per-transaction: an EIP-3009 nonce is one-time use, so one payer paying twice under the same ATR reproduces the same authorization and the token rejects the second with no LCP-level diagnostic. LCP §6.1 wants a per-transaction ATR anyway.
